en.title: Taiwan Labor Bureau Launches Vocational Rehab-Job Fair Initiative for Disabled Persons
en.summary: The Taiwan Labor Bureau announced a vocational rehabilitation program paired with a job fair to support persons with disabilities. Meanwhile, Missouri enacted a new ADA website accessibility law, and Purdue released an app converting handwritten text to compliant HTML. Additional highlights include Tainan’s bus service accessibility upgrades, a long‑running sidewalk ramp campaign in El Centro, and research showing the financial returns of web accessibility investments.

highlights.title: Labor Bureau Promotes Vocational Rehabilitation Combined with Job Fair to Support Persons with Disabilities in Realizing Potential

zh-TW.title: 勞工局 推動 職業復原 與 徵才 結合 支援 障礙者 就業
zh-TW.summary: 勞工局宣布職業重建計畫結合徵才活動，以支持身心障礙者發揮潛能。同時，密蘇里州實施新ADA網站無障礙法，普渡大學推出手寫文字轉HTML的無障礙應用程式。其他重點包括臺南公車無障礙升級、El Centro 長期爭取人行道坡道的倡議，以及研究顯示網站無障礙帶來的投資回報。
